grammar_focus: 复习 KS12/36/60 一般将来时(方案B换情节包):will do(将来预测/临时决定)与 be going to do(计划、迹象)的辨析;when/if/as soon as 引导的从句用一般现在时表将来;将来时的否定与疑问
scene: 我们班下个月要上演一出话剧。“这会是很大的工作量,”老师说,“但我保证一定很有意思。”等票开始出售时,我们会邀请所有家长来看。米娅打算设计戏服,里奥负责画布景。“万一当天下雨,我们就把一切都搬到室内。”“你打算在剧里唱歌吗?”我问山姆。“是的,我这一周每天晚上都要排练。”演出七点才开始,所以我们有充足的时间准备。灯一暗下来,第一场戏就要开始了。“我觉得这会是我们学校有史以来最棒的一场演出!”

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS12/36/60 一般将来时
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习“将来”的两种主要说法及其区别:①will do——对将来的预测,或说话当下临时做的决定(I'm sure it will be fun);②be going to do——事先已定的计划、打算,或根据迹象作的判断(Our class is going to put on a play);③when / if / as soon as 引导的时间、条件从句里,一律用一般现在时表示将来(When the tickets go on sale, we will invite the parents),从句不用 will;④否定用 won't,疑问把 will 提前或用 Are you going to…。

rows: I'm sure it will be fun. / I'll help you carry it.
be going to do(计划/迹象)
Our class is going to put on a play. / It's going to rain.
When the tickets go on sale, we will invite the parents.
The show won't start until seven. / Are you going to sing?

specialRules.rule: 美语“剧院、戏院”常写 theater(英式 theatre);“排队”说 stand in line(英式 queue)。本课已按美语写。
已定的计划用 be going to,当场的决定用 will,迹象征兆判断用 be going to;when/if/as soon as 从句里用现在时,别用 will。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What is the class going to do next month?

passage: Our class is going to put on a play next month. "It will be a lot of work," the teacher said, "but I'm sure it will be fun." When the tickets go on sale, we will invite all the parents. Mia is going to design the costumes, and Leo will paint the background. "If it rains on the day, we will move everything indoors." "Are you going to sing in the play?" I asked Sam. "Yes, I am. I am going to practice every evening this week." The show won't start until seven, so we will have time to get ready. As soon as the lights go down, the first scene will begin. "I think this is going to be the best play our school has ever seen!"
